headline: Fruit Ninja: 1 billion downloads
title: Fruit Ninja Passed 1 Billion Downloads | Halfbrick Facts | Classic Games
video_script: Fruit Ninja is a simple idea: slice the fruit, avoid the bombs. Australian studio Halfbrick released it in April twenty ten, and it grew fast. It passed four million sales by December twenty ten, and twenty million downloads by March twenty eleven. In twenty fifteen, Halfbrick announced one billion downloads, right on the game's fifth anniversary. Were you a high score hunter? Comment below!
description: Fruit Ninja by Australian studio Halfbrick launched in April 2010 and Halfbrick announced one billion downloads in August 2015 around the game's fifth anniversary.
